cells.gaps: No source found says taxpayer numbers are issued from a computerised register in service. The TIN linked to the national ID was announced in 2024; nothing says it launched.
cells.note: ITAS, a single platform for taxpayer registration, is being built with rollout due from end-2026 (SOM-001), and a TIN linked to the national ID was announced in 2024 (SOM-002). Intent stops at stage 2; nothing shows a register in service, so not 3.
